name: ACBR
blurb: ACBR is a free and open source comic book reader and converter.
description:
ACBR is a free and open source comic book reader and converter.

Main Features:

• Compatible file formats: CBZ, CBR, CB7, PDF, EPUB, MOBI 7, FB2, JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF

• Single and double page modes, page rotation, integrated video and audio player, metadata editor, Komga and Kavita server browser, RSS reader, partial gamepad support...

• UI available in: English, Spanish, Russian, German, Arabic, Filipino, Japanese and French

Included Tools:

• Convert, resize or extract comic book files

• Convert and resize image files

• Extract color palettes from images

• Create comic book page and thumbnails templates

• Search for and open public domain online books and audiobooks

• Search for and open RSS feeds from podcasts and websites

• Search for and open radio station streams

• ...

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
